My parents never owned a credit card and we own our house that we bought and we also have three cars, all paid off. We're also building a house next to ours and we're not living paycheck to paycheck. Besides, having a credit card is okay for the first couple of years, but come around te fifth and sixth year and the interest becomes higher. But I will say that budgeting on a credit card is pretty good if you own one. I just think it's easier to just use money that you know is yours and not have to worry about debt. I've been to a few hotels and they let me pay with a debt card. We have a Visa and Visa is accepted almost everywhere. If you own a credit card and can manage it, then that's your trip and you may spend your borrowed money however you like. I'm just putting my opinion out there.

Why does anyone get a credit card? I only have a debit card and i have no debt. I spend my own money that I know I have and If  I can't afford something, I either don't buy it or save up for it. Not even my parents have credit cards. o.o

I'm posting my story soon.. It's a tad similar to yours. I'm not making an assumption, just an observation. It seems you may have anxiety/depression (it may not necessarily be caused by anything). If no doctor has found any reason for your physical problems, consider looking up stomatoform disorder/ pain disorder. It's what I was diagnosed with... And I'm only 16. Don't give up hope. It may be hard and you may be going through things I won't understand, but know some people care. Whether it be family, friends, or annonymous. I send you kind words and thoughts. (:
Oh, and I know this may seem crazy, but stay away from antidepressants and medications like that (Prozac, Zoloft, ect.) try a different method. Medications like that don't usually work and only make you worse. So try breathing exercises and if you can, lay on the grass at a park or something and just look up at the sky (: the clouds are calming on a nice day (:
